buyer.stated_criteria_quote: high-quality distribution warehouses and other industrial properties that are leased to creditworthy corporate customers
buyer.acquisitions_head_title: Partner and Chief Investment Officer of Industrial, Ares Real Estate Group
buyer.notes: Ares Industrial REIT (AIREIT, non-traded) 'invests in... distribution warehouses and other industrial buildings leased to corporate clients'; NJ portfolio 16 buildings, 98% occupied. NJ deals seen: I-80 Logistics Park, Wayne 557,000 SF, $138.5M (2022); 14-building 1.12M SF Cinnaminson/Pennsauken portfolio from Whitesell, $118.5M (2024); Heron Industrial Center NJ $26M (2021, BCI IV). Ares acquiring GLP Capital Partners international business (incl GCP US). HQ Los Angeles per TRD. David Kaplan acted for Ares on South Jersey deal. AIREIT FY2025 10-K: 'building a national industrial warehouse operating company'; acquisition, development and/or financing of income-producing assets; creditworthy does not mean investment grade - majority of customers unrated. Ares/PSP $2.4B JV (2026) seeded with NJ assets (see PSP row). | Non-traded, publicly registered REIT; formerly Black Creek Industrial REIT IV (renamed 2022-02 after Ares bought Black Creek's advisory business 2021-07-01). NJ deals seen: Wayne / I-80 Logistics Park, 20-30 & 25 Continental Dr, 557,000 SF (2022-06-29, $138,500,000; seller Hartz Mountain). TRD: AIREIT NJ portfolio = 16 buildings, 98% occupied (2022). Also bought 48-property / 8.3M SF portfolio from Prologis across 13 markets (2021-07, ~$920M). INFERRED: buys large stabilized Class A bulk and portfolios ($100M+); not a sub-250K SF single-asset buyer.
